name: uploads-mod
description: Claude Code add-on for the uploads plugin: shows staged screenshots above the prompt, attaches them when gh pr create opens a PR, and reminds you to stage screenshots before a UI PR.

autoPromote.title: Attach staged files on gh pr create
autoPromote.description: When the repo isn't linked to your workspace, run `uploads attach --promote` after `gh pr create` opens a PR. Off: the mod only tells you and Claude what is waiting.
